output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is directly assigned to the balanceOf[target], without considering the overflow situation. If initialSupply is set to a large value, attackers can mint arbitrary amount of tokens to any user's balance.
The transfer function does not check if the target address is frozen, allowing attackers to freeze user accounts.
The transferFrom function does not check if the target address is frozen, allowing attackers to freeze user accounts.

The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is directly subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender], without considering the overflow situation. If attackers can manipulate the totalSupply to a small value, attackers can mint arbitrary amount of tokens to any user's balance.

The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is directly used in a multiplication, without considering the overflow situation. If attackers can manipulate the sellPrice to a large value, attackers can mint arbitrary amount of tokens to any user's balance.
